messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — service=hosted-inference, incident=INC-7123, urgency=high. Trigger: 5xx rate >5% over 2m. pd.incident/7123 link: https://pagerduty.example/INC7123 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Primary on-call notified: @jordan. Escalation schedule: primary -> secondary -> manager.

jordan: acked. digging in. looking at metrics now — heatmap shows token-serving p95 spiking and a bunch of 503s from inference hosts.

maria: (automated page) i missed the initial page, on my way — ETA ~3min. can someone dump recent logs?

jordan: past 5m from grafana: 
```
service=hosted-inference error_5xx_rate 2m=6.8% 1m=7.3%
hosts with highest 5xx: inference-gpu-5(34%), inference-gpu-3(21%), inference-gpu-9(14%)
request_lat_p95=820ms -> baseline 120ms
```

samir: checking host metrics, gpu memory looks fine, but OOM killer entries on inference-gpu-5 around the same time. pulling pod logs.

jordan: trying safe failover to dedicated pool. running: `kubectl patch deployment hosted-inference -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"redwood/force-fallback":"true"}}}}}'`

pagerduty-bot: Secondary (maria) did not acknowledge within 2m; escalating to manager (alex).

maria: omg my phone was on DND, just saw this. sorry. confirming logs — i see repeated `kvcache miss` and spiky tail-latency.

alex: on my way. starting manager bridge: https://meet.example/ops/7123 (pst)

ops-bridge: bridge created. brief recap on join.

jordan: mitigation step 1: scale up dedicated pool and route new requests off noisy hosts. running autoscale override: `redwoodctl capacity set --pool dedicated-hosted-inference --replicas 6`

samir: taking inference-gpu-5 out of rotation: `redwoodctl host drain inference-gpu-5 --reason "elevated 5xx"`

maria: confirming drain started. LB will stop sending new requests in ~15s.

pagerduty-bot: Manager escalation acknowledged by alex.

alex: questioned impact: how many customers effected? jordan do we have per-customer error rates?

jordan: quick estimate: top 3 customers saw 12-18% elevated 5xx; global error volume ~0.8% of requests but concentrated on some mid-size customers. sending a short incident impact note to #customer-impact channel after we stabilize.

samir: logs from inference-gpu-5: repeated lines: `ERROR: model_inference.cpp: KV cache allocation failed: alloc(2048MB) returned null` plus a few `503 upstream request timed out`. suspecting memory regression in latest model shard rollout.

maria: that matches the rollout timeline — we pushed model-v12 to 3/5 noisy hosts ~10:04. rolling back model on drained hosts. `redwoodctl model rollback --host inference-gpu-5 --model model-v11`

jordan: rollback started, host health checks will take ~30s.

pagerduty-bot: Incident status changed — Mitigating.

ops-bridge: bridge: can we delay canary rollouts until postmortem? alex: yes, pause all model rollouts org-wide.

maria: pausing rollout config: `redwoodctl rollout pause --scope org` — done.

samir: after drain & rollback, error rate dropped to ~1.1% within 2m and p95 latency down to 160ms.

jordan: rebalancer completed, traffic rerouted away from inference-gpu-5 and -3. verifying customers impacted: created a list and drafted customer note.

alex: communicate to support and CSMs: brief timeline + who is impacted + ETA for postmortem. keep message concise.

jordan: posting to #customer-impact: "We experienced elevated errors for hosted inference between 10:03–10:18 UTC affecting a subset of customers. Root cause appears to be a model shard rollout causing KV cache allocation failures on specific hosts. Mitigation: rollback of model-v12 on affected hosts and traffic reroute. Full postmortem to follow."

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by primary and manager. auto-escalation suppressed.

maria: double-checking for latent errors: running sweep across hosts for any model mismatch. `redwoodctl host check-models --all` — all good.

samir: found one host (inference-gpu-9) still running model-v12 on a minority of shards, stepping to rollback as well.

jordan: after rollbacks, 5xx rate stabilized under 0.5% for 6m. declaring mitigated. marking incident as customer-impact P2 -> reduction from P1.

alex: good ops. quick notes for postmortem: reproduce locally, add preflight check for KV alloc on rollout, block rollouts if alloc fails on 1+ host, add alert that correlates model rollout events with 5xx spike.

maria: will own the postmortem and coord with model team. timeline: initial alert 10:03, rollback began 10:08, mitigated 10:18. impact window ~15m.

jordan: adding follow-ups to this thread: 1) postmortem draft by EOD, 2) customer message to CSMs, 3) automation to scrub DND on primary pager if manager escalation fires (we should not rely on DND for secondary).

ops-bridge: closing bridge. thanks all — keep updates in this thread for the postmortem. :thumbsup:

alex: marking incident resolved in PD. nice work.

incident-bot: Incident INC-7123 — Resolved. Summary: Model-v12 shard rollout caused KV allocation failures -> host-level 5xx spike. Mitigation: rollback, host drain, dedicated pool scale-up. Postmortem owner: maria.

jordan: added labels: severity=P1, cause=deployment_regression, action=rollback, followups=[postmortem, rollout-guardrails, customer-notify].

maria: will ping model infra tomorrow for a deeper RCA and test harness for KV alloc checks.

samir: saving logs to /var/incident/INC-7123/logs.tar.gz and adding to the PD incident.

jordan: thanks team. closing thread after postmortem verification.
